Over the past few months, right-wing parties and leaders have faced electoral setbacks across countries including Romania, Hungary, Serbia, the U.S. and Brazil, while youth-led protests in India are challenging the grip of Narendra Modi’s government.
Do these developments signal a wider global shift? Has the populist far right finally entered a period of decline? Here, we discuss the question.
